column3: {actor_name:1}... wake up!\nThe mountain is shaking!{end_wait}
Please, sweetheart...\nwake up. Please.{end_wait}
The Boulder's coming down.\nGet him up. Now.{end_wait}
Come on, {actor_name:1}.\nWe're leaving. Right now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, wait!\nYou forgot something.{end_wait}
It's pouring out there.\nPut your tunic on.{end_wait}
Do you have everything\nyou need? Think fast.{end_now}
I'm sorry. There's no time.\nLeave it. We'll replace it,\nif we're still alive.{end_wait}
Good. Stuff can be\nreplaced, {actor_name:1}.\nPeople can't.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, Dora, hurry!\nThe Boulder's going to\ndrop any second!{end_wait}
Kyle, can they hold it?{end_wait}
Not for long. Go. Now.{end_wait}
Get to the plaza, both of\nyou. I'll catch up.{end_wait}
You're coming too,\nright?{end_wait}
Not yet. People are still\ntrapped in their homes.{end_wait}
Then let me help!\nI'm not leaving you!{end_wait}
No. It's too dangerous.\nDora, please. Take care\nof {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} can make it to\nthe plaza on his own.\nHe's not a baby.{end_wait}
You know the way,\n{actor_name:1}. Don't you?{end_now}
You're old enough now,\n{actor_name:1}. Go on alone.\nPlease, honey.{end_now}
South. Straight to the\nplaza. Don't stop for\nanyone. Be careful!{end_wait}
Huh? {actor_name:1}?\nWhat are you doing here?{end_wait}
Did you come back for me?{end_now}
Sorry I shoved you. I've\njust got to get out of\nhere. Now.{end_wait}
This is no time to play,\nboy! Move, or die here!{end_wait}
We'd better get to the\nplaza before the Boulder\nfinds us.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, what do you want?\nI'm trying to save my\nthings!{end_wait}
What, you want me to just\ndump everything I own?
I guess dragging a heavy\nchest around like this\nisn't very safe...{end_wait}
...Yeah. You're right.\nIt's only stuff. Let's go.{end_wait}
You're not leaving me\nhere, are you, {actor_name:1}?\nNot like this.{end_now}
I guess dragging a heavy\nchest around like this\nisn't very safe...{end_wait}
...Yeah. You're right.\nIt's only stuff. Let's go.{end_wait}
Hey! {actor_name:1}!\nThank God it's you!{end_wait}
Are you trapped too?{end_now}
Hmph. It's not like you to\nget caught off guard,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Oh. You saw the elders go\nto help the others?\nGods keep them.{end_wait}
Thank goodness. Stay with\nme. I don't want to be\nalone out there.{end_wait}
Everyone's heading south,\nto the plaza. If it holds,\nthat's where we live.{end_wait}
Not north. North is the\nmountain. That's where\nit's falling from.{end_wait}
The plaza's that way.\nSouth. Come on.{end_wait}
The rock blocks the path.\nWe can't get through!{end_wait}
Then we find another way.\nFast.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}The Boulder! It's\nfalling! Run! Run!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Ugh...{pause_20_skippable} Ughnn...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nIt's too heavy! We can't\nhold it much longer!{end_wait}
If our Psynergy gives out,\nVale dies with us!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Hold... hold on! Until\nthe last of them is safe!{end_wait}
Hurry, boys! Run!!!\nDon't look back!{end_wait}
Run, {actor_name:1}!\nIt's right behind us!{end_wait}
The rockslide... it took\nthe fence. The monsters\nare getting in...{end_wait}
I'm hurt... badly. Do you\nthink I'm going to die?{end_now}
I knew it... Leave me.\nSave yourselves...{end_wait}
Gods... you're really\nleaving me here. For the\nmonsters to...{end_wait}
Wait... that's strange...\nI'm not even hurt!{end_wait}
But the monsters are real.\nBe careful. Please.{end_wait}
I knew it... Leave me.\nSave yourselves...{end_wait}
Oh no... my brother!\n{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Hang on, {actor_name:5}!\nPlease, hang on!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} will be fine.\nWe'll find a way to\nsave him. We have to.{end_wait}
The rope won't reach.\nWe need Psynergy. Do you\nhave any left?{end_wait}
I'm empty. Kyle? Please\ntell me you have some.{end_wait}
I'm drained. I spent it\nall getting people out...\nI'm sorry.{end_wait}
We need help. Someone...\nanyone with Psynergy.{end_wait}
Can {actor_name:5} hold on\nlong enough? Can he?{end_wait}
There's nothing else we\ncan do for him here...\nis there?{end_wait}
Then get help. Be quick!\nEvery second counts!{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}, go with them.\nPlease. I'll stay here.{end_wait}
You'll find help...\nwon't you?{end_wait}
Your brother is counting\non you, {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
All right. Let's go.{end_wait}
I'll check the north path.\nYou go to the plaza. And\ndon't follow me.{end_wait}
Yes, ma'am. Anyone with\nPsynergy left. Anyone\nat all.{end_wait}
You saw it, didn't you?\nYou saw what happened.{end_now}
I have to find help before\n{actor_name:5} drowns!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} fell in the river.\nI need someone with\nPsynergy. Please!{end_wait}
I don't suppose... could\nyou two help me? Please.\nI can't do this alone.{end_now}
{actor_name:6} went to the plaza\nfor help. Go to her.{end_wait}
You don't have to help.\nJust get yourselves to the\nplaza. Live.{end_wait}
Oh, {actor_name:1}... thank\ngoodness. Thank goodness.{end_wait}
You two can't save {actor_name:5}\nwith what we have left.\nFind help. Hurry.{end_wait}
Hang on, {actor_name:5}! Help is\ncoming! Don't let go!{end_wait}
Don't let go, {actor_name:5}!\nDon't you let go!{end_wait}
Huh? Are you asking if I\ncan use Psynergy,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Ten years ago, I'd have\nhelped. Now I'm just an\nold woman. Forgive me.{end_wait}
I thought not. Psynergy\nbelongs to the young and\nstrong. Not to me.{end_wait}
You want an old woman to\nuse Psynergy now?{page_break}Don't ask the impossible.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Ohhh... I'm spent.{page_break}I used everything I had\nturning rocks aside...\nIt wasn't enough.{end_wait}
Oh no. Little {actor_name:5} fell\nin the river?{page_break}That's why {actor_name:6} looked\nso frightened...{end_wait}
I have a little Psynergy\nleft. Not much. Enough\nto try.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} went that way!\nShe was crying.{end_wait}
Please... help {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
Do you know what became\nof the Boulder from Mt.\nAleph?{end_now}

What? It's coming down on
the village? The elders are
holding it back?{page_break}They're the strongest
Adepts we have. If they
fail... Gods.{end_wait}
They always said it would\nfall someday.{page_break}I knew a storm like this\nwould shake it loose.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} begged me to help\n{actor_name:5}.{page_break}I would, if it didn't take\nPsynergy. I'm so sorry.{end_wait}
Go to the elders! They\ncan't hold the Boulder\nmuch longer!{end_wait}
We can't let the Boulder\nbury Vale. We can't.{end_wait}
Let's help the elders.\nNow.{end_wait}
We're all counting on you.\nDon't fail us.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, {actor_name:1}...\nyou came to help me?{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} told me about\n{actor_name:5}. Is that why you\ncame?{end_now}
Whatever the reason, I\nneed you two to help\n{actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Good boys. {actor_name:6} could\nuse your help.{end_wait}
There. I'm charged. Let's\ngo.{end_wait}
How are you holding up?\nIs your Psynergy back?{end_wait}
Enough for {actor_name:5}. The\nPsynergy Stone helped.{end_wait}
Good. {actor_name:6}, you heard\nhim. Run. Hurry!{end_wait}
The path may be blocked.\nYou two know the way.\nShow them.{end_wait}
Every second counts!\nHurry, boys!{end_wait}
Mom! Dad!{pause_20_skippable} We're back!\nPlease... answer me!{end_wait}
...{actor_name:6}? Is that\nyou?{end_wait}
I couldn't find anyone who\ncould help.{page_break}...What about you? Did\nyou find someone?{end_wait}
You're in time. Barely.{end_wait}
Then my brother's still...\nhe's still alive?{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} is alive.{pause_20_skippable}\nHe's hanging on.{end_wait}
Come down here! Help us\nsave {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
No...{pause_20_skippable} It can't be. Kyle...\nTell me it's a dream...{end_wait}
Mom... Dad...{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:5}...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nPlease...{pause_20_skippable} Don't leave me\nhere alone...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}... the Boulder...\nIf we don't get help,\neveryone drowns...{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Oh...{pause_20_skippable} oh gods...{pause_20_skippable} I'll go.\nI'll go!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}It's no use.{pause_20_skippable} I can't\nmove...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:1}, please!\nGet help!{end_wait}
I can't let him go alone...\nI won't.{end_wait}
Times like this, men stand\ntogether. Even the scared\nones.{end_wait}
Only two of us made it...\nand I don't know why.{end_wait}
We never imagined the\nSanctum would answer like\nthat.{end_wait}
It's a miracle we two\nwalked out of it alive.{end_wait}
That switch...\nIt was a trap. Had to be.{end_wait}
But a storm like this\nfrom one trap? Unreal.{end_wait}
...Alchemy shows its teeth\nagain. Beautiful.{pause_20_skippable} Terrible.{end_wait}
We must not fail when we\nchallenge the Sanctum\nagain.{end_wait}
Next time...{pause_20_skippable} we have no\nchoice but to succeed.{end_wait}
You were listening to us,\njust now...\nweren't you?{end_now}
{actor_name:1}... they look\nfrightening.{page_break}Are you sure you should\ntalk to them?{end_wait}
You must forget what you\nheard tonight. All of it.{end_wait}
Don't be afraid...\nWe'll help you forget.{end_wait}
The door won't open.{page_break}The impact must have torn\nit off its hinges. We're\ntrapped.{end_wait}
You think I should leave\neverything and just save\nmyself?{end_wait}
If a rock hits now, I lose\nmy chest and my life both.\n...Stupid choice.{end_wait}
You're right. It's only\nstuff. Let's get out of\nhere.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! Is that roof\nfixed yet? The next storm\nwon't wait for us.{end_wait}
Almost done? Good.\nKeep at it.{end_wait}
Heh... still training,\n{actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
You put your whole heart\ninto it, {actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
Oh. I'm just finishing up.\nDon't mind me.{end_wait}
Good. It's time, and I was\nabout to leave without you.{end_wait}
Say... what happened to\nyou two, back then?{end_wait}
The night of the storm...\nIs that why you two study\nPsynergy so hard?{end_wait}
I just want to forget it.\nI wish everyone would.{end_wait}
That night... we went for\nhelp. They found us\nunconscious in the mud.{end_now}
Well... let's get {actor_name:1}\nand go to Kraden's.{end_now}
Huh? You were going to say\nsomething, weren't you?{end_wait}
Don't be weird, {actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
Keep up, or I'll leave you\nbehind.{end_wait}
That's... good. Thank you,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You're so dependable,\n{actor_name:1}. Just like your\nfather was.{end_wait}
What is it, {actor_name:1}?\nDo you still think about\nthat night?{end_now}
You and {actor_name:2} work\nyourselves to the bone,\nchasing Psynergy.{end_wait}
Would anything have been\ndifferent if you'd been\nstronger? Be honest.{end_now}
When Kyle died, I thought\nI'd break in two.{end_wait}
I felt completely alone...\nlike I was underwater.{end_wait}
It's taken time. I'm\nbetter now. Mostly.{end_wait}
I still have you,{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:1}.\nThat's enough to go on.{end_wait}
You're almost seventeen.\nYou're so like Kyle at that\nage. It hurts to see.{end_wait}
I want to see where life\ntakes you. I need to.{end_wait}
Kids and their games...\nas if it never happened.{end_wait}
Alchemy... I wonder what\ngood it ever did us.{end_wait}
Your mother would rather\nsee you grow into a happy,\nordinary man.{end_wait}
But I suppose you'll go\nanyway...{end_now}
Well. If that doesn't stop\nyou, nothing will.{end_wait}
It's kind of you to humor\nme. I know you don't mean\nit.{end_wait}
You're as stubborn as your\nfather was. God help me.{end_wait}
This old house is barely\nstanding. It won't take\nmuch more.{end_wait}
Kraden's waiting for us.\nLet's go to his house.\nBefore I change my mind.{end_wait}
Well, if it isn't {actor_name:1}.\nAnother quiet day here...\nQuiet. Always quiet now.{end_wait}

Kraden had visitors this
morning. They didn't give
their names.{page_break}I wonder where they went...
I wonder what they want.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name}. Have you\nmeditated on Mt. Aleph\ntoday?{end_now}

Good. Meditation keeps the
peace here, they say.{page_break}If everyone had prayed
harder, maybe that night
would've gone differently.{end_wait}
Shame on you, {protagonist_name}.\nMt. Aleph watches over us.{page_break}Meditate. Every day...\nIt's all we have.{end_wait}
You had a terrible time\nthree years ago. Didn't\nyou?{end_now}

You lost your father...
{actor_name:6} lost everyone. It
was awful.{page_break}At least her grandparents
took her in. Thank
goodness.{end_wait}
You're strong, {actor_name:1}.\nYou dealt with it.{page_break}But I couldn't bear to\nsee {actor_name:6} like that.{end_wait}
They say we're a chosen\npeople. Our Psynergy proves\nit.{page_break}Chosen for what, I wonder.{end_wait}

My grandfather was a
powerful Adept. I was
taught to be proud.{page_break}I never asked what it cost
him. Maybe I should have.{end_wait}
Those travelers who came\nthrough... did they see\nthe mayor?{end_now}

I told them where Kraden
lives. Not one thank you.
They barely looked at me.{page_break}Strange folk. They watched
everything.{end_wait}
A visitor greets the mayor.\nThat's decency.{page_break}Those people have none. I\ndon't trust them.{end_wait}
Psynergy rewards practice.\nBut I wonder... should\neverything be practiced?{end_wait}
Hey, {protagonist_name}. Have I\nshown you my new trick?{end_now}
It took years of work to\nget this good, {protagonist_name}.{end_wait}
Really? Fine, here's a\nlittle sample.{end_wait}
Behold! The power of\nPsynergy! Hah!{pause_20_skippable} ...Well? Not\nimpressed?{end_wait}
If your Psynergy runs low,\nwalk. It comes back slowly.\nEverything does.{end_wait}
Puppies are playing over\nthere.{page_break}Let them. Something here\nshould get to play.{end_wait}

Those who wield Psynergy
are called Adepts.{page_break}We're supposed to be the
servants of good. Never
forget that, they say.{end_wait}

Our Psynergy came from Mt.
Aleph. A divine gift, they
say.{page_break}It's why wishes come true
here. When they come true.{end_wait}
Psynergy is for peace.\nIt must never be used for\nevil. Never.{end_wait}

A good blade isn't only
sharp. It draws out the
strength of its wielder.{page_break}My father said that. I
finally understand what
he meant, {protagonist_name}.{end_wait}

Good armor isn't only
sturdy. It draws out the
strength of its wearer.{page_break}That's what they say. I
don't know what it means.{end_wait}
A wise man flees a fight\nwhen he's hurt. Dead heroes\ndon't feed anyone.{end_wait}
My father died in that\nstorm, too.{page_break}I'm sharpening my skills.\nNext time, I'll be ready.{end_wait}
My son's still young. I\ndon't work him too hard.{page_break}He's like his father. He'll\nbe fine. He has to be.{end_wait}

Those three travelers I
have staying here...
I doubt they're thieves.{page_break}But something's wrong with
them. I feel it.{end_wait}

One of them wore a mask.
Never took it off. Not
even to eat.{page_break}Scars, maybe. Or maybe
something worse.{end_wait}
Two of our three guests\nwent out this morning.\nThey didn't say where.{end_wait}
Then we have nothing to\ndiscuss. Be off.{end_wait}
Then stop wasting my time.{end_wait}

Visitors should introduce
themselves to the mayor.
It's basic respect.{page_break}There's a group in town
that won't. What's this
world coming to?{end_wait}
Kraden has guests again.\nPopular, for a sage.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2} has grown strong\nthese three years.{page_break}Keep an eye on him. He\nhides how he's doing.{end_wait}
You and {actor_name:2} are older.\nThere's no time to waste\nplaying around.{end_wait}
Your stone crushed my\nflowers! My mother's\nflowers!{end_wait}
I'll get you for those\nflowers. Just see what\nhappens...{pause_20_skippable} tonight.{end_wait}
You're in trouble now,\n{actor_name:2}.{page_break}Your sister's furious.{end_wait}
I told that oaf {actor_name:2}\nit was fine.{page_break}But what do I do about\nthis hole?{end_wait}
No rain for a while,\nit seems.{page_break}So I'll have you fix it\nlater, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
My granddaughter {actor_name:6}\nsmiles again, finally.{page_break}I owe you and {actor_name:2}\nthat, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Don't take {actor_name:6} outside\nthe village. I've lost\nenough.{end_wait}

{actor_name:6} is her mother's
image. We lost her that
day.{page_break}I just want her to be
happy. Safe.{end_wait}
Kraden came to Vale to\nstudy Mt. Aleph, didn't he?{end_now}
He said he studies Mt.\nAleph. Alchemy and such.{page_break}Aleph... Alchemy...\nAre they connected?{end_wait}
I thought... never mind.{page_break}If he advances the sages'\nwisdom, good for him.\nSome knowledge isn't free.{end_wait}
When outsiders are here,\nwe can't use Psynergy.{page_break}The old laws say its\nsecret must never be told.{end_wait}
Do you dream of the world\noutside the village?{page_break}Someday I'm leaving Vale.\nI swear I am.{end_wait}

Few outside Vale have
Psynergy. That's why we
need permission to leave.{page_break}...To protect the secret.
That's what they tell us.{end_wait}
Old man Kraden's got\nvisitors.{page_break}Let's scare 'em with some\nPsynergy. Want to?{end_now}
You're more of a prankster\nthan I thought...\nI like that.{end_wait}
You're too serious,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}Only someone with Psynergy\nwould guess it was us.{end_wait}
Do you hear those growls\npast the fence? Nothing\nnatural sounds like that.
You hear it too, don't you?\n{text_effect:4}I... I'm scared...{end_wait}
Really? Only I can hear\nthem? Then maybe I'm\ngoing mad.{end_wait}
It looks just like it did\nthree years ago, after\nthe storm...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, stay back from\nthe river! Please!{end_wait}

Food's stored in this hut,
so winter isn't scary.{page_break}If only things had been
different three years
ago... if only.{end_wait}
Do you need to go past\nhere?{end_now}
You must be heading to\nKraden's cottage...\nWatch yourself.{end_wait}

Don't go beyond Kraden's
cottage.{page_break}The monsters are thick out
there. They don't leave
survivors.{end_wait}
Mt. Aleph looks peaceful\ntoday. Beautiful, even.\nThat's what scares me.{end_wait}
Vale stays pure because of\nMt. Aleph.{page_break}Taint that purity and the\nmountain will answer.{end_wait}
I envy you, {actor_name:2}. Your\ngrandpa's the mayor.{page_break}Do you envy him too,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Yeah... When travelers\ncome, he hears all about\nthe outside world.{end_wait}
Hmph. I can't believe you\ndon't envy him, {actor_name:1}.{page_break}I'd give anything to hear\na traveler's stories.{end_wait}

Vale must stay hidden.
Psynergy's secrets can't
reach the wrong hands.{page_break}That's our oldest law.
Handed down for a reason.{end_wait}
They know so little of\nthe Sanctum's mysteries.\nAlmost nothing.{end_wait}
The elders will let no one\ninside. Not even Kraden.\nNot even him.{end_wait}
Kraden...{pause_20_skippable} Could he be of\nuse to us?{end_wait}
His knowledge is not small.\n...Yes. We can use him.{end_wait}
But he's more stubborn\nthan we hoped.{end_wait}
And clever, too...\nDangerously clever.{end_wait}
If he won't come\nwillingly, we can always...{end_wait}
Were you listening to our\nconversation?{end_now}
Oh? Well... I can't let\nyou keep spying on us.{end_wait}
Hmph.{pause_20_skippable} I suppose I should\ntake you at your word.{end_wait}
Sneaking?{pause_20_skippable} Who are you to\naccuse me?{end_wait}
So Kraden's appointment\nwas with you...{end_wait}
Yeah. We're going to him\nright now.{end_wait}
And this appointment is\nimportant enough to\ndrive us off?{end_now}
Pfeh. If your errand\noutweighs ours, then...\ngo.{end_wait}
Regardless, Kraden sent us\naway. He is waiting for\nyou.{end_wait}
Are you sure, Saturos?\nThey heard everything.{end_wait}
Menardi, they are children.\nWe have no reason to\nhold them.{end_wait}
Go on, children. Don't\nkeep Kraden waiting.{end_wait}
Leave. Before we change\nour minds.{end_wait}
Just... who were they?\nThey felt wrong.{end_wait}
They know too much about\nSol Sanctum...{end_wait}
...things even the elders\nof Vale don't know.{end_wait}
The elements of Alchemy:\nearth, water, fire, wind...{page_break}They mean to set them\nin motion?{end_wait}
And the four Elemental\nStars are the key?\nGods help us.{end_wait}
Even I, a trained sage,\ndo not know these things.{end_wait}
It's those two, isn't it?\nSaturos and Menardi,\nI believe.{end_wait}
Are they still out there?\nThey don't give up easily.{end_wait}
Did they want something\nfrom you, Kraden?{end_wait}
I think so...{end_wait}
You think so?{end_wait}
Mt. Aleph, Sol Sanctum...{page_break}They spoke as if they had\nseen them. With their\nown eyes.{end_wait}
Yes.{pause_20_skippable} No one climbs Mt.\nAleph without a very good\nreason.{end_wait}
I waited years before they\nlet me into the Sanctum.{page_break}Of course it's strange.{end_wait}
And if they sneaked in,\nthey might be thieves!{end_wait}
We have to tell the high\nelders and the village!{end_wait}
I don't know how much of\nwhat they said is true.{end_wait}
We can't act until we have\nconfirmed what they said.{end_wait}
We confirm it ourselves.{end_wait}
...You mean go into Sol\nSanctum? Ourselves?{end_wait}
Just because Mt. Aleph is\nforbidden?{end_now}
We only want to see if\nthey've been up there.{page_break}Surely that's acceptable...\nisn't it?{end_wait}
That's right. We're only\nchecking whether they've\nbeen to Mt. Aleph.{end_wait}
We'll be fine if no one\nsees us. Right?{end_now}
Sure, you say no. But\nyou want to.{end_wait}
This stays our secret.\nOkay?{end_now}
No, {actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} Not a word to\nyour mother. Promise.{end_wait}
You'll be our leader.\nOkay, {protagonist_name}?{end_now}

There are dangerous
places between Mt. Aleph
